text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins) (No. 4)
Notification 2015
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 1 January 2016 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

The centre coin features the Singapore Coat of Arms with the year‑date “2016” below it, and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around it.
The centre coin is surrounded by 12 coins, each with a design identical to that of the centre coin.
The centre coin features a local orchid hybrid, the Papilionanthe Singapore Golden Jubilee, minted with full colour, above which is the denomination “$10”. Both are circumscribed by the words “SINGAPORE THIRD ALMANAC COIN SERIES”.
Each of the 12 coins surrounding the centre coin depicts an animal of the design featured in the third Chinese Almanac Coin Series, together with the year of issue for that animal, both in Arabic numerals and in Chinese characters. The denomination “$2” is below each design.
